decisions.reason: The range builds on the firm's existing consumer health and pharmacy distribution knowledge, letting it interpret early market responses and improve the line.
Its positive launch and close fit with the firm's OTC/consumer health capabilities enable the firm to assimilate feedback and continue developing it.
The clear launch message and alignment with existing health information and customer channels support learning, so the firm retains it.
Mushroom-based immune supplements draw on specialized nutritional knowledge distant from the firm's pharmaceutical core, leaving it unable to adequately interpret weak early signals.
The Valsartan contamination problem creates regulatory and quality risks that overwhelm the firm's ability to learn from early results, making withdrawal likely.
